findings.original_title: Docetaxel 100 mg/m2 protocol has an incorrect ANC boundary and an unsupported platelet rule
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00202 rebuilt against the current source with corrected ANC handling, removal of unsupported platelet treatment logic, hepatic pathways and source defined toxicity handling.

findings.original_title: Weekly paclitaxel plus trastuzumab has an incorrect platelet threshold and missing cardiac, hepatic and toxicity pathways
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00815 rebuilt with the source platelet bands, LVEF assessment, hepatic assessment and toxicity pathways.

findings.original_title: AT 50/75 has an incorrect ANC threshold and broad underencoding
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00423 rebuilt with the corrected ANC boundary and broader organ and toxicity context.

findings.original_title: CMF oral omits the NCCP 75 percent haematology band, DPD logic and organ function tables
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00377 rebuilt with the intermediate haematology dose band, DPD pathway and component specific renal and hepatic logic.

findings.original_title: CMF IV 28 day is materially underencoded
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00378 rebuilt with the intermediate haematology dose band, DPD pathway and component specific renal and hepatic logic.

findings.original_title: CMF IV 21 day is materially underencoded
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00381 rebuilt with the intermediate haematology dose band, DPD pathway and component specific renal and hepatic logic.

findings.original_title: EC90 lacks source defined renal, hepatic and cardiac context
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00262 now includes source reconciled renal, hepatic and cardiac context. Tiered renal thresholds use a protocol specific selector.

findings.original_title: EC75 lacks source defined organ and cardiac context
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00263 now includes source reconciled renal, hepatic and cardiac context. Tiered renal thresholds use a protocol specific selector.

findings.original_title: FEC50 lacks DPD, organ function and occurrence based haematology logic
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00269 now includes DPD, component specific organ function and detailed haematology logic.

findings.original_title: Eribulin 28 day omits source defined dose reduction, renal, hepatic and nonhaematological toxicity pathways
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00743 now includes phase specific haematology, recurrent dose level logic, renal and Child Pugh pathways and severe non haematological toxicity handling.

findings.original_title: Gemcitabine 800 monotherapy is materially underencoded
findings.v0680_disposition: NCCP 00749 now includes cycle day specific haematology, renal and bilirubin context, dialysis timing review and severe toxicity handling.

findings.original_title: Assessment completeness can mean only that all encoded rules were evaluable
findings.v0680_disposition: Visible completeness wording has been replaced by Encoded rule coverage wording so source completeness is not implied.

findings.original_title: Most protocols do not expose a meaningful encoding maturity status
findings.v0680_disposition: All 376 active protocols now carry an explicit encoding maturity state. Legacy records are conservatively labelled as pending full source fidelity review.

findings.original_title: Exact duplicate conditions can produce different action types
findings.v0680_disposition: The audit now uses component aware conflict logic. Thirty five exact condition groups remain because different drug components legitimately require different actions. Zero exact condition conflicts remain for overlapping components.

findings.original_title: Modified FOLFIRINOX contains a rule where the named field is ignored by engine precedence
findings.v0680_disposition: The modified FOLFIRINOX hand foot syndrome rule now evaluates the intended field and no longer mixes condition syntaxes.

findings.original_title: Ten select rule conditions can never be selected by the current input options
findings.v0680_disposition: The ten stale unreachable cisplatin select rules were removed. The current integrity audit reports zero unreachable select values.

findings.original_title: A substantial number of rules lack encoded source provenance
findings.v0680_disposition: Every active rule now contains a source object. Legacy source objects explicitly state when full source fidelity reconciliation is still pending.

findings.original_title: A substantial number of rules lack explicit explanations
findings.v0680_disposition: Every active rule now contains an explanation. Source reconciled explanations remain distinct from conservative legacy explanations.

findings.original_title: Many visible inputs are not linked to deterministic rules or required dependencies
findings.v0680_disposition: Every visible input now has an explicit role of decision, monitoring, context or documentation. This distinguishes rule driving inputs from informative fields.

findings.original_title: Fluoropyrimidine protocols show a residual DPD coverage review queue
findings.v0680_disposition: The corrected breast fluoropyrimidine records were reconciled. Three residual DPD screening signals remain and require current source confirmation before any rule change.

findings.original_title: Several HER2 and anthracycline protocols lack explicit cardiac inputs
findings.v0680_disposition: Several corrected breast records now include cardiac context. Residual HER2 and anthracycline cardiac screening signals remain for source review.

findings.original_title: Several taxane protocols lack explicit hepatic input coverage
findings.v0680_disposition: The source reconciled breast taxane records now include hepatic context where required. A residual taxane hepatic screening queue remains for source review.

findings.original_title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor endocrine monitoring is not uniform
findings.v0680_disposition: Immunotherapy endocrine screening remains deliberately optional and immunotherapy specific. Ten residual platform screening signals remain for current source review.

findings.original_title: Three shared indication mappings remain unresolved
findings.v0680_disposition: Primary source recheck showed that NCCP 00212 does not include Lung. The earlier audit signal was a false positive and Lung was removed. NCCP 00215 is correctly cross listed to Breast, Gynaecology, Gastrointestinal and Lung.

findings.original_title: The Change Tracker has not yet completed its first live NCCP source comparison
findings.v0680_disposition: The first complete live NCCP source comparison has not completed in this build environment. The clinician interface must continue to show the source check as pending until a successful source inspection occurs.

findings.original_title: Closed change history is not yet fully persistent in the reader facing tracker
findings.v0680_disposition: The tracker still needs a permanent reader facing archive of closed changes with reviewer, rationale and applied release.

findings.original_title: The regimen search writes raw user query text into innerHTML
findings.v0680_disposition: Regimen search no longer interpolates raw query text into innerHTML. Search status content is built with text nodes.

findings.original_title: Legacy clinical screens and hard coded assessment logic remain in the production index
findings.v0680_disposition: Legacy hidden clinical screens and hard coded historical logic remain in the production page. They are not the preferred workflow but should be removed in a future architecture cleanup.

findings.original_title: Protocol Importer exposes internal publication mechanics and obsolete module version labels
findings.v0680_disposition: The protocol preview remains inside developer tools and visible wording no longer exposes publication mechanics or repository instructions.

findings.original_title: Some public assets still use historical module cache keys without the cumulative app key
findings.v0680_disposition: All active local JavaScript and CSS assets now carry the cumulative v0.68.0 application cache key.

findings.original_title: Source review and record identity metadata are incomplete
findings.v0680_disposition: All 376 active protocols now carry a canonical protocol identifier. Source checked dates remain absent on 193 records and NCCP review dates remain absent on 253 records because dates were not fabricated without source confirmation.

findings.original_title: Most regimen cards still carry nonblocking metadata review debt
findings.v0680_disposition: Seventy regimen cards are metadata complete and 306 retain nonblocking review items, mainly duration, intent or cycle interval.

findings.original_title: Evidence relationship taxonomy is inconsistent
findings.v0680_disposition: The active knowledge base now uses a controlled evidence relationship taxonomy.

findings.original_title: Duplicate evidence objects exist
findings.v0680_disposition: All evidence records now carry canonical evidence identifiers so repeated publications share identity. Physical duplicate evidence objects remain and can be normalised later without affecting the current reader experience.

findings.original_title: Five evidence records lack the newer structured trial fields
findings.v0680_disposition: All 66 current evidence records now contain structured population, intervention, comparator, primary endpoint and key findings fields.

findings.original_title: Historical knowledge data are shipped in the production site
findings.v0680_disposition: The production site build now publishes only the current knowledge data file. Historical knowledge data remain in development history but are not shipped in the active static site.

findings.original_title: Legacy hidden screens account for most remaining unlabelled controls
findings.v0680_disposition: The modern generic workflow is labelled and keyboard oriented, but legacy hidden screens still account for most remaining form label debt.

findings.original_title: Validation notes can persist locally and be exported as free text
findings.v0680_disposition: The validation workspace carries a stronger no patient identifier warning and now requires an explicit identifier free confirmation before JSON or CSV export. Free text remains possible, so reviewer discipline is still required.

findings.original_title: National antiemetic migration is complete in active supportive care links
findings.v0680_disposition: National NCCP antiemetic guidance remains the active supportive care destination and the existing emetogenic traffic light model is preserved.

findings.original_title: All active protocols point to official HSE source domains
findings.v0680_disposition: Active source links continue to use official HSE domains. Source currency still depends on the successful change tracker inspection.

findings.original_title: No active protocol is marked as clinically authorised
findings.v0680_disposition: No active protocol is marked as clinically authorised. Formal validation remains pending.

findings.original_title: The existing cumulative automated suite is green but does not prove source fidelity
findings.v0680_status: Strengthened but not closed by automation
findings.v0680_disposition: The cumulative automated suite is green and source fidelity sentinels were added for the high priority reconciliations. Automated testing still cannot prove full clinical source fidelity across all 376 protocols without source by source human review.
